start.title: Getting started
start.subtitle: Installed the app? Follow these steps to put your first agent to work.

activate.label: Activate the app
activate.title: Activate GPTThink on your portal
activate.step1: Open GPTThink from the applications menu of your Bitrix24.
activate.step2: Follow the instructions on the first screen to finish activating the portal.
activate.step3: Once activation is done, the list of agents is available to you.

create.label: Create the agent
create.title: Create your first agent
create.step1: In the list of agents, click "New agent".
create.step2: Give the agent a name and describe how it should behave.
create.step3: Save. The agent shows up in the list and is ready to be trained and tested.

train.label: Train
train.title: Teach the agent about your business
train.step1: Open the agent and go to the training area.
train.step2: Add the texts and answers the agent should know.
train.step3: Talk to it in the test chat and fix what did not come out well.

intentions.label: Intentions and functions
intentions.title: Define what the agent does
intentions.step1: Pick a ready-made function, such as SDR, Support or Scheduling.
intentions.step2: Adjust the intentions to your service process.
intentions.step3: Test the conversation again to check that the agent follows what you set.

channel.label: Activate on the open channel
channel.title: Put the agent to work
channel.step1: Connect the agent to a Bitrix24 open channel.
channel.step2: Define when the conversation goes to a person and what to do outside business hours.
channel.step3: Activate the agent. The next conversations on the channel are handled by it.

credits.label: Credits and plan
credits.title: Track consumption
credits.step1: Open the plan area to see your credit balance.
credits.step2: Each agent reply uses credits, depending on the AI model you chose.
credits.step3: You get warnings when the balance is running low.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.q1: Do I need to know how to code to create an agent?
faq.a1: No. You create the agent, describe its behavior and train it in the app itself, inside Bitrix24.
faq.q2: On which channels does the agent respond?
faq.a2: On the Bitrix24 open channels you connect to the agent.
faq.q3: Can the agent use my CRM data?
faq.a3: Yes. It can read and write information in Bitrix24 while serving the customer, according to the actions you enable.
faq.q4: Can I test the agent before putting it to work?
faq.a4: Yes. The test chat lets you talk to the agent before activating it on the channel.
faq.q5: What happens when credits run out?
faq.a5: Consumption is tracked inside the app, and you get warnings before the balance runs out. Check your balance in the plan area.
faq.q6: Can my team take over a conversation?
faq.a6: Yes. You define when the conversation goes to a person on your team, and the history stays on the channel.

cta.title: Bring AI agents into your Bitrix24
cta.text: Install from the Bitrix24 Market and follow the getting-started steps to put your agent to work.
